title: user.contact.changed
description: Where this person can be written to. Emitted by the single observer in stapel_auth.contact_projection for every write that establishes or changes a deliverable address — registration, OAuth first login, guest upgrade, authenticator change, admin edit, shell — not by any individual view. Distinct from user.created/user.updated, which carry the identity row for shadow users tables: this carries one narrow, privacy-sensitive fact for the service allowed to write to a person. email and phone are always present and are empty strings when unset, so an address the account gave up can be cleared; delivery is at-least-once, so the consumer's apply must be an upsert.

user_id.description: The account the addresses below belong to.

email.description: E-mail address, or "" when the account has none.

phone.description: E.164 phone number, or "" when the account has none.

email_verified.description: Whether the e-mail address has been proven.

phone_verified.description: Whether the phone number has been proven.
